description.en: A radial seed-bearing disc is attached to a central stalk.
description.zh: 放射对称带种盘连接中央柄。

scientific_scope.en: Fossil-specimen concept for Peltaspermum retensorium, limited to the preserved organ or thallus described here; no complete parent organism is implied.
scientific_scope.zh: Peltaspermum retensorium 的化石标本概念，仅限本文所述保存器官或叶状体，不暗示已知完整母体。

distinctness.en: Open umbrella-like disc with underside seed positions differs from Caytonia's enclosed cupules and conifer cones.
distinctness.zh: 开放伞状盘及下侧种子位置区别于Caytonia包围式种子杯和针叶树球果。

modeling_brief.en: Build a shallow scalloped disc above its stalk; show a restrained ring of underside attachment points.
modeling_brief.zh: 构建柄上的浅波缘盘，在下侧表现简化的一圈着生点。

uncertainty: Only the reproductive specimen is counted; associated foliage genera are excluded from separate entries.
reference_notes: Planning record only. Source access labels distinguish opened pages from indexed abstracts/excerpts. Reference-ready is not a released model or a completed dimensional/rights audit.

sources.title: The oldest known peltasperms with radially symmetrical ovuliferous discs
sources.supports: Permian Peltaspermum retensorium radial seed-bearing discs.
